open_points.subject: Model M02 — SourcePhotoObservation.size
open_points.text: a file rejected before its bytes were read has the size its metadata gave when it was listed
open_points.question: Does “before its bytes were read” mean before any byte was read or before all bytes were read, and therefore what is `size` when reading succeeds only for a prefix before the file is rejected?
options: Use the number of bytes successfully read before rejection.
Use the listed metadata size whenever the complete file was not read.
Define that partial reads cannot produce an observation and use a separately specified size value.
open_points.default_guess: Use the number of bytes successfully read before rejection; use metadata size only when zero bytes were read.

witness.initial: A confirmed project contains a regular file whose metadata reports 1000 bytes and whose first 400 bytes can be read before a read failure.
events: The owner starts the calling flow.
The calling flow asks the deliverer to scan the project.
The deliverer lists the file, reads 400 bytes, then rejects it as `unreadable_file`.
outcomes: The observation has `size = 400`, because some bytes were read.
The observation has `size = 1000`, because the file's bytes were not completely read before rejection.
witness.observer: The calling flow reading the scan result.
